notes: Unofficial fan project. No official ATLUS artwork, sprites or logos are used or referenced.
DESIGN NOTE: stats, weaknesses and resistances are balance approximations inspired by the games, not exact ports.

DESIGN NOTE: skills are stored once in `skillLibrary` and referenced by personas via { skill, unlockLevel }. The data loader (src/data/cards.js) resolves each reference into a full skill object { name, type, power, spCost|hpCost, unlockLevel, description, effect }. This keeps the file small and means new cards never touch engine code.

DESIGN NOTE: Patch 3 ships two ailments, Burn and Shock. Canonically these come from fire and electric skills, so they are applied via `ailment` + `ailmentChance` on those damage skills rather than via dedicated ailment-only skills. `type: "ailment"` remains a valid schema value for future cards. RULE: an ailment chance is the ONLY randomness a skill may carry, and the card text must print the percentage.

DESIGN NOTE: `usesAction` is stored on every Item and Special. Per the rules, playing Items/Specials is separate from your one action, so it defaults to false; the two strongest Specials set it to true.

RULE: you may play at most ONE Item card and ONE Special card per turn (engine constants ITEMS_PER_TURN / SPECIALS_PER_TURN). The two limits are counted separately, so one of each in the same turn is legal.
RULE: prebuilt decks contain no Persona above level 25 (CONFIG.DECK_MAX_PERSONA_LEVEL). Everything stronger is fusion-only, and every fusionOnly Persona is the result of exactly one recipe.

RULE: a Persona card may only be played to the field if its printed level is at most the highest level among your field Personas + CONFIG.PLAY_LEVEL_GAP (default 10). High-tier cards wait in hand until your board grows into them.

RULE: a Persona card may print at most ONE `passive`. Passives are always-on or auto-triggered, never an activated choice, and are implemented as hooks in src/engine/passives.js. The ids allowed here are listed in meta.passives.

DESIGN NOTE: `quality` (1-5) on every Item and Special is the hand-assigned strength tag used by Momentum Draw (engine/effects.js). Personas score themselves from printed level + skill count, so they need no tag.

RULE: a Special that prints a number deals that number FLAT (`"flat": true` + `amount`). Only weakness, resist and guard change it — never stats, buffs, Shock or Charge. Card text and behaviour are asserted equal by tests/engine.specials.test.js.

RULE: decks are GENERATED, not hand-built. A deck entry here is a flavour (P3/P4/P5) and nothing more; the 30 cards are drawn from that flavour's pool (its own cards plus every `common` one) and weighted by the archetype the player chose. See src/data/archetypes.js. `affinity` on each card is that weighting, 0-3 per archetype.

RULE: every Persona ENTERS PLAY AT FULL SP — starters, cards played from hand, fusion results and revivals alike. SP then regenerates in the ACTIVE SLOT ONLY (CONFIG.SP_REGEN_PER_TURN); benched Personas neither gain nor lose SP. Scarcity is a spending problem, not an arrival problem. Skill costs are tuned against that tap: ~6 is a light probe, 8 a workhorse, 14+ something you save for or pay for with an item.
RULE: `deckGroup` puts cards under a shared per-deck cap (meta.deckGroupCaps). SP-restore items are capped at 2 per deck between them, so no deck can paper over the SP economy.
RULE: `alacrity: true` on a skill means a knockdown from it refunds a Persona change (CONFIG.ALACRITY_REFUND). It is the Swift keyword: hit, rotate, hit again.

RULE: `exclusive: 'p3'|'p4'|'p5'` locks a card to one flavour's pool. Each flavour also declares a `flavourLean` archetype axis, which the deck builder weights on top of the player's own archetype choice — that is what makes P3 swing, P4 grind and P5 scout.

RULE: no skill has a random chance to knock a Persona out. The Hama and Mudo lines are ordinary Light/Dark damage skills with a deterministic `execute` rider (CONFIG.EXECUTE_MULT) — Hama against a knocked-down target, Mudo against one below 40% HP.

RULE: drain SKILLS, not drain affinities. `drain: "hp"` on a damage effect heals the attacker for exactly the damage dealt; `kind: "drainSp"` deals no damage and moves up to `amount` SP from the enemy active to yours. Both are Almighty, so neither has any weakness, resist or Technical interaction.

RULE: a Skill Card is an Item whose effect is `{ kind: "teachSkill", skillId }`. It permanently adds that skill to one of your field Personas for the rest of the match. It may only ever name an entry in `skillLibrary`, so it can never teach a passive. `deckGroup: "skill-card"` caps them at meta.deckGroupCaps["skill-card"] per deck.

RULE: draw manipulation is deterministic and seeded. `guaranteedDraw` reserves the next draw for a Persona of a named Arcana (`best: true` takes the highest-level one); `fateFetch` reserves it for a Persona that answers the enemy active's weaknesses, widening from revealed-only to all of them at CONFIG.WHIMS_DEFICIT; `providence` looks at the top CONFIG.PROVIDENCE_LOOK cards and discards any of them. A reservation ALWAYS overrides Momentum Draw weighting and the draw-level floor for that draw, and is spent whether or not it found anything.

RULE: `kind: "inflict"` applies a named ailment with certainty and deals no damage. It is the only guaranteed way to start a Technical — every other source is a percentage rider on a fire or electric skill, and every one of those prints its odds.

RULE: `percentOfTargetHp` on a damage effect replaces the power curve entirely: the hit deals that fraction of the target's CURRENT HP, modified only by weakness, resist and guard, exactly like a flat Special. Taking a share of what remains can never reduce it to zero, so a percentage skill never lands a knockout.

RULE: `rewriteAffinities` replaces a Persona INSTANCE's weakness and resist lists, preserving the count of each, clearing everything anyone had revealed, and setting `rewritten`. Every reader goes through state.affinitiesOf, and a rewritten Persona is opaque even to the Brutal bot — its cheat is reading the card, and the card no longer describes it. One exclusive per flavour: Turn of the Moon (P3), Jester's Trickery (P4), Change of Heart (P5).

RULE: `traesto` is the tactical retreat. Its effect `{ kind: "retreat" }` returns one of your field Personas to your hand as the SAME INSTANCE — a hand entry carrying a `persona` blob — so its level, skills and passive survive. Capped at 1 per deck by meta.deckGroupCaps.

spirit-drain.description: Deals no damage. Steals up to 6 SP from the enemy active Persona — a net gain of 5.

personas.name: Pixie
personas.flavor: A tiny fairy whose healing spells outshine her fists.

personas.name: Jack Frost
personas.flavor: Hee-ho! A cheerful snow spirit with a mean cold streak.

personas.name: Apsaras
personas.flavor: A celestial dancer of clouds and water.

personas.name: Orpheus
personas.flavor: The Master of Strings. A first awakening, fragile but bold.

personas.name: Izanagi
personas.flavor: A masked figure with a long blade and a longer silence.

personas.name: Arsene
personas.flavor: The Pillager of Twilight. A gentleman thief in scarlet.

personas.name: Ara Mitama
personas.flavor: A rough soul. All courage, no subtlety.

personas.name: Angel
personas.flavor: Bound in leather, bearing judgement without expression.

personas.name: Jack-o'-Lantern
personas.flavor: A pumpkin-headed prankster with a lantern full of fire.

personas.name: Hua Po
personas.flavor: A flower spirit born from a burning tree.

personas.name: Koppa Tengu
personas.flavor: A small crow tengu: all bluster, short flights and a borrowed sword.

personas.name: Omoikane
personas.flavor: A deity of wisdom who thinks before it strikes.

personas.name: Nekomata
personas.flavor: A two-tailed cat demon with very sharp opinions.

personas.name: Kaiwan
personas.flavor: A star-reading spirit. It has already seen how this ends.

personas.name: Incubus
personas.flavor: A nightmare that visits sleepers and leaves them drained.

personas.name: Silky
personas.flavor: A housemaid spirit who tidies the battlefield.

personas.name: Ippon-Datara
personas.flavor: A one-legged smith demon swinging a red-hot hammer.

personas.name: Yaksini
personas.flavor: A fierce attendant wielding a cleaver and a grin.

personas.name: Berith
personas.flavor: A duke of hell astride a red horse.

personas.name: Take-Minakata
personas.flavor: A thunder god who lost a duel and never forgot it.

personas.name: Mothman
personas.flavor: Red eyes in the dark. An omen with wings.

personas.name: Sarasvati
personas.flavor: Goddess of knowledge, music and flowing water.

personas.name: Unicorn
personas.flavor: A pure white charger whose horn burns away corruption.

personas.name: Anzu
personas.flavor: A storm bird whose wings carry away whole seasons.

personas.name: Mithra
personas.flavor: A god of contracts. Break one and find out.

personas.name: Kikuri-Hime
personas.flavor: A mediator goddess standing between the living and the dead.

personas.name: Titania
personas.flavor: Queen of the fairies, crowned in light and wind.

personas.name: Rangda
personas.flavor: The demon queen of Bali, eternal enemy of Barong.

personas.name: Girimehkala
personas.flavor: A one-eyed elephant whose gaze turns misfortune back on you.

personas.name: Vasuki
personas.flavor: The serpent king coiled around the churning of the sea.

personas.name: Black Frost
personas.flavor: Hee-ho... A Jack Frost that went bad. Very bad.

personas.name: Surt
personas.flavor: The fire giant who will burn the world at its ending.

personas.name: Thanatos
personas.flavor: Death itself, wrapped in coffins and silence.

personas.name: Odin
personas.flavor: The All-Father, one eye traded for every answer.

personas.name: Yoshitsune
personas.flavor: A tragic general who never lost a battle, only the peace.

personas.name: Messiah
personas.flavor: A saviour built from grief and the will to carry it.

personas.name: Satanael
personas.flavor: The rebel who fires a bullet through fate itself.

personas.name: Izanagi-no-Okami
personas.flavor: The god who sees through every fog. Has no weakness.

items.name: Medicine
items.description: Restore 50 HP to one of your Personas.

items.name: Bead
items.description: Fully restore HP of one of your Personas.

items.name: Bead Chain
items.description: Restore 40 HP to all of your Personas.

items.name: Snuff Soul
items.description: Restore 18 SP to one of your Personas.

items.name: Chewing Soul
items.description: Restore 36 SP to one of your Personas.

items.name: Soma
items.description: Fully restore HP and SP of one of your Personas and cure its ailments.

items.name: Revival Bead
items.description: Revive a knocked-out Persona on your bench at 50% HP. Does NOT reduce the opponent's KO tally.

items.name: Amrita Soda
items.description: Cure all status ailments on one of your Personas.

items.name: Sapping Device
items.description: Lower the enemy active Persona's defense for 3 turns (Rakunda).

items.name: Muscle Drink
items.description: Raise your active Persona's attack for 3 turns (Tarukaja).

items.name: Smoke Bomb
items.description: Swap your active Persona for one on your bench. Costs neither your action nor your Persona change for the turn.

items.name: Steak Skewer
items.description: A meal worth stopping for. Fully restores one of your Personas and cures its ailments. Free — but it is the one Item your turn allows.

items.name: Skill Card: Agilao
items.description: Teach Agilao to one of your field Personas for the rest of the match. Medium Fire damage, and a way to cover an element your board simply does not have. It costs 8 SP to cast, like any other skill.

items.name: Skill Card: Rakukaja
items.description: Teach Rakukaja to one of your field Personas for the rest of the match. Raises defense for 3 turns. It costs 6 SP to cast, like any other skill.

items.name: Skill Card: Life Drain
items.description: Teach Life Drain to one of your field Personas for the rest of the match. Light Almighty damage that heals the user for what it dealt — sustain for a Persona that had none. It costs 8 SP to cast, like any other skill.

specials.name: Theurgy
specials.description: Your active Persona unleashes its ultimate. Deals exactly 60 Almighty damage to the enemy active Persona — stats, buffs and Charge do not change it. Uses up your action.

specials.name: Armageddon
specials.description: A fusion spell that engulfs the whole enemy field. Deals exactly 30 Almighty damage to EVERY enemy Persona, active and benched. Uses up your action.

specials.name: Ambush
specials.description: You caught them off guard. This turn, your attacks and offensive skills may target any single enemy Persona, including benched ones.

specials.name: SP Transfer
specials.description: Move up to 18 SP from one of your Personas to another.

specials.name: Baton Pass
specials.description: Hand off the momentum. You may change your active Persona one extra time this turn.

specials.name: Dekaja
specials.description: Remove all buffs from the enemy active Persona.

specials.name: Dekunda
specials.description: Remove all debuffs from your active Persona.

specials.name: Concentrate
specials.description: The next magic skill your active Persona uses deals x2.5 damage.

specials.name: Charge
specials.description: The next physical skill your active Persona uses deals x2.5 damage.

specials.name: Fortune's Draw
specials.description: Name an Arcana still in your deck. Your next draw is guaranteed to be a Persona of that Arcana.

specials.name: Growth Ritual
specials.description: Every Persona on your bench gains +1 level. Your active Persona is busy fighting and gains nothing.

specials.name: Marionette Strings
specials.description: Force the opponent to switch. Their active Persona is pulled to the bench and their strongest healthy benched Persona steps up in its place — you do not get to choose which.

specials.name: Third Eye
specials.description: Read the enemy active Persona: all of its weaknesses and resists are revealed to you for the rest of the match.

specials.name: Full Analysis
specials.description: Scan the opponent's hand. You may look at every card in it until the end of your turn.

specials.name: Velvet Summons
specials.description: Call one of your knocked-out Personas back from the Velvet Room to your hand. It does NOT reduce your opponent's KO tally. Uses up your action.

specials.name: Soul Inversion
specials.description: Swap your active Persona's remaining HP and SP. Neither can exceed its maximum, and it can never drop below 1 HP.

specials.name: Wild Card
specials.description: Borrow the last skill your opponent used and cast it yourself, free of HP or SP cost. Uses up your action.

specials.name: Phantom Strike
specials.description: Playable only once the enemy active Persona's weaknesses and resists are fully revealed. The next skill you land on one of its weaknesses deals +50% damage and costs no SP.

specials.name: Shuffle Time
specials.description: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Draw one of them; the other two go to the bottom.

specials.name: Persona Evolution
specials.description: Your active Persona breaks through and learns the next skill printed on its card, whatever level that skill would normally need.

specials.name: Dark Hour
specials.description: The hour between days. For one full round, every skill and attack — yours and theirs — deals x1.5 damage. Specials that print a flat number are unaffected.

specials.name: Moonless Gown
specials.description: Your active Persona takes NO damage until the start of your next turn — and cannot act for that whole time.

specials.name: Whims of Fate
specials.description: Fate looks for the answer to whatever is in front of you. Your next draw becomes a Persona from your deck that can hit one of the enemy active Persona's weaknesses. It matches only weaknesses you have already UNCOVERED — unless you are behind by 4 or more knockouts, in which case it matches every weakness, revealed or not. It does not reveal anything. If your deck holds no answer, you draw as normal.

specials.name: Arcana Reading
specials.description: Name an Arcana still in your deck. Your next draw becomes the HIGHEST-level Persona of that Arcana you have left.

specials.name: Providence
specials.description: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Discard any number of them; the rest stay on top, in the order they were.

specials.name: Lesser Theurgy
specials.description: Choose Burn or Shock and inflict it on the enemy active Persona. No targeting, no roll: it always lands. You may only choose an ailment it does not already have — Shock sets up a physical Technical this turn; Burn sets up a fire/wind one and keeps burning meanwhile.

specials.name: Turn of the Moon
specials.description: The hour turns and your active Persona turns with it: its weaknesses and resists are rewritten. The new chart is drawn at random, keeps the same number of weaknesses and resists, and is hidden from everyone again — including a Brutal opponent, whose knowledge comes from the card and the card no longer applies.

specials.name: Jester's Trickery
specials.description: A shuffle of the cards nobody asked for. Rewrite the weaknesses and resists of ANY one Persona on your field. The new chart is drawn at random, keeps the same number of weaknesses and resists, and is hidden from everyone again — including a Brutal opponent, whose knowledge comes from the card and the card no longer applies.

specials.name: Change of Heart
specials.description: Steal both hearts at once: BOTH active Personas have their weaknesses and resists rewritten. You lose everything you had scouted on them, and they lose everything they had on you. The new chart is drawn at random, keeps the same number of weaknesses and resists, and is hidden from everyone again — including a Brutal opponent, whose knowledge comes from the card and the card no longer applies.

specials.name: Twist of Fate
specials.description: Uses up your action. Name an element: it replaces ONE of the enemy active Persona's weaknesses, and you cannot name something it resists. Your opponent decides which weakness is given up, and they will shed one you had already uncovered before one you had not. The new weakness is revealed to both of you.

specials.name: Traesto
specials.description: Uses up your action. Pull one of your field Personas back into your hand. It is the same body: it keeps its level, every skill it has learned or inherited, its passive and its SP. Its ailments, buffs and debuffs are gone and its HP is fully restored. If it was your active Persona, one of your choice steps up from the bench for free. It is never a knockout, and it ignores the play-level ceiling coming back down — it was already yours.

decks.name: Burning Bravery
decks.tagline: P3 Deck — steady healers, thunder and a coffin waiting to open.
decks.playstyle: Haymaker — big SP skills, its own SP economy, and swings that end rounds.

decks.name: Reach Out To The Truth
decks.tagline: P4 Deck — blunt physical pressure and a fog that hides nothing.
decks.playstyle: Midrange grind — healing, buffs and steady growth. Outlast, then out-know.

decks.name: Take Your Heart
decks.tagline: P5 Deck — curses, ambushes and stolen momentum.
decks.playstyle: Scout then strike — probe for weaknesses, swap into the counter, hit once and hard.
